questions.stem: What is the value of Avogadro's constant?
questions.explanation: Avogadro's constant (NA) is 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹. This means one mole of any substance contains exactly 6.02 × 10²³ particles (atoms, molecules, or ions).

questions.stem: How many moles are in 36 g of water (H₂O)? (Ar: H = 1, O = 16)
questions.explanation: Mr of H₂O = (2 × 1) + 16 = 18, so the molar mass is 18 g/mol. Using n = m/M = 36/18 = 2 mol.
